staff.heading: Data requests
staff.intro: Requests to see, move, correct or delete someone’s data. Each one must be answered within a month of the day it reached us; the list shows the nearest deadline first.
staff.notAllowed: Only owner, admin and support staff handle data requests.

identity.not_needed: Not needed: made inside the account
identity.denied: The person says it wasn’t them

parentIdentity.not_needed: Not needed: made inside the account
parentIdentity.asked: Waiting for the parent or guardian
parentIdentity.confirmed: Confirmed by the parent or guardian
parentIdentity.denied: The parent or guardian says nobody asked

new.heading: Log a data request
new.intro: Find the person, then say what they asked for, how it reached us and when. The deadline is one month from the date received.
new.findHint: A username, a pen name, a whole email address or a user ID. Finding someone by email is logged.
new.pickHint: Pick the account the request is about.
new.matchNoHandle: An account with no username yet
new.receivedHint: Not in the future. The deadline is one month from this date.
new.noteHint: Only staff read it. Never paste the person’s email, documents or data here.

page.heading: Data request {{reference}}
page.under16: This person is under 16, so the request goes through their parent or guardian, never only through the account.
page.identityExplainAsk: This request didn’t come from inside the account. Ask the person to confirm it was theirs: they get a notice they can’t switch off, emailed to the account’s own address, and answer in Settings, under Data requests. Nothing goes to any other address.
page.identityExplainAsked: We asked the person to confirm. Their answer will show here.
page.identityExplainDone: Signing in to their own account is the check. The answer is in the audit log.
page.extendHint: Up to two more months in all, and only within the first month. The person is told the new deadline and why.
page.extendTooLate: The first month is over, so the deadline can no longer be extended.
page.closeHint: Say what was done. It stays in the log as our proof; the person doesn’t read it.
page.closedNote: This request is closed and can’t be changed.
page.extendedFully: The deadline already has the most extra time the law allows: two more months.
page.identityExplainParent: This person is under 16 and the request didn’t come from inside their account, so we check with the parent or guardian who agreed to the account. They get an email at the address from that agreement with a link to answer. Nothing goes to an address taken from the request.
page.identityExplainParentAsked: We emailed the parent or guardian who agreed to the account. Their answer will show here.
page.identityExplainParentDone: The parent or guardian answered from the link we emailed to the address in their agreement.
page.askParentAgain: Email the parent or guardian again

failures.not_allowed: Only owner, admin and support staff handle data requests.
failures.no_such_person: That account doesn’t exist any more. Search again.
failures.bad_date: The date received can’t be in the future.
failures.note_too_long: The note is too long: keep it under 2000 characters.
failures.request_closed: This request is closed and can’t be changed.
failures.reason_needed: Say why you need more time, in at most 1000 characters.
failures.bad_months: Pick more time than the deadline already has.
failures.too_late: The first month is over, so the deadline can no longer be extended.
failures.no_check_needed: This request was made inside the account, so it needs no check.
failures.parent_needed: This person is under 16: the check goes to their parent or guardian.
failures.outcome_needed: Say what was done, in at most 2000 characters.
failures.refused: That wasn’t saved. Check the fields and try again.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the database. Try again in a moment.
failures.not_a_copy: This request isn’t for a copy of the data.
failures.identity_denied: The person told us this request wasn’t theirs.
failures.bad_files: The copy’s files weren’t right. Try building it again.
failures.no_file: A file didn’t arrive. Try building the copy again.
failures.not_found: That file or copy isn’t there any more. Reload the page.
failures.not_under_16: This person is 16 or over, so they confirm the request themselves.
failures.no_parent_on_record: No parent or guardian has agreed to this account, so there is nobody we may write to. Answer the request by post or ask the person to make it from inside their account.
failures.parent_email_failed: The email to the parent or guardian didn’t go. Try again in a minute.

mine.heading: Data requests
mine.intro: Your requests to see, move, correct or delete your data, and when we’ll answer.
mine.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your data requests. Try again later.
mine.title: {{reference}}: {{type}}
mine.question: This request reached us {{channel}}, not from inside your account. Was it you?
mine.denied: You told us it wasn’t you. We won’t act on it, and we’ll look into it.
mine.answerFailed: We couldn’t save the answer. Try again.

copy.heading: The copy
copy.intro: The copy holds everything the person put here and their account data as a machine-readable file (data.json), every story and every story’s plan as a Word file and a PDF, and their library as a spreadsheet. It is built in this tab, in the person’s language, then the person downloads it from Settings while signed in, for seven days. Nothing goes to any other address.
copy.introParent: The copy holds everything the person put here and their account data as a machine-readable file (data.json), every story and every story’s plan as a Word file and a PDF, and their library as a spreadsheet. It is built in this tab, in the person’s language. On this request it goes to the parent or guardian who agreed to the account: we email them a one-time link at the address from that agreement, for seven days. The person isn’t told and doesn’t see the files.
copy.building: Building the copy. Keep this tab open until it’s sent.
copy.sent: The copy is sent. The person has a notice and an email, and can download it for seven days.

blocked.not_a_copy: This request isn’t for a copy of the data, so no copy is sent.
blocked.parent_needed: This person is under 16 and the request didn’t come from inside their account, so it goes through their parent or guardian. Ask them first, under Identity check.
blocked.identity_denied: The person told us this request wasn’t theirs, so nothing is sent.
blocked.identity_not_checked: Check the person’s identity first: ask them to confirm the request was theirs.

copy.openHint: You don’t need to read the files to send them. Opening one is logged.
copy.sentToParent: The copy is ready. We emailed the parent or guardian a one-time link to it; the person isn’t told.

blockedParent.identity_denied: The parent or guardian told us nobody asked for this, so nothing is sent.
blockedParent.identity_not_checked: Wait for the parent or guardian to confirm the request first.

parentLink.heading: The parent’s link
parentLink.notSent: The link to the copy hasn’t been emailed yet. Send it below.
parentLink.sent: Emailed {{sent}}. Not opened yet. It works once: one hour from the first opening.
parentLink.opened: Emailed {{sent}}, first opened {{opened}}. It worked for one hour from then.

parent.goneBody: A newer email may have replaced it, or the request is closed. If you need help, contact us.
